title: skills.yml
description: Toggle individual skills (built-in or user-added) and override their severity.

enabled.description: Allowlist for USER-added skills: if non-empty, only the user skills named here run (built-in skills always run regardless). If empty, all auto-discovered user skills run.

disabled.description: Skill names to skip even if loaded. The core security skills cannot be disabled: the built-in L1 validators C1-C4 (ready-to-merge, ci-green, owner-approval, base-up-to-date), C5 trailers, the classifier-publisher gate, bot-self-repo, break-glass audit, and unauthorized-push. Naming one of them here is rejected by this schema AND ignored at runtime (runtime.NON_DISABLEABLE).

severity_overrides.description: Per-skill severity override (keys = skill names, values = P0/P1/P2/P3). A core L1 validator (C1-C5, classifier-publisher) cannot be downgraded below blocking (P0/P1) — such an override is ignored.
